scope: Approved EV B1 steps 4-6; reports and B2/B3/B4 excluded

step4.fixed_model: Kennedy DR pseudo outcomes, bandwidth and cohort frozen once; query never refits
step4.sensitivity: derivative of the frozen Gaussian local-linear smoother; seconds per incentive unit
step4.threshold: first mesh-supported crossing of declared contrast target; numerical cells and conditional finite-grid candidates, not causal threshold confidence set
step4.uncertainty: conditional cluster sampling only; no smoothing/nuisance/reference/process propagation

step5.encoder_training: train users only; histories completed before target notice
step5.head: shared continuous DR; L/U always retained; six representation columns (C0 zeros); effective capacities differ
step5.selection: validation mean contrast-curve RMSE vs evaluator truth; require all validation blocks available and lower mean than C0; tie simpler; then fixed test
step5.outcome: raw observed cumulative response seconds; representation use isolated from process solver

step6.reference: same existing frozen model and past-only selection for all processes; truth evaluator only
step6.representation: step5 aggregate validation winner, frozen rule; no final-panel selection
step6.effect: same Kennedy DR per measured outcome; plugin/unadjusted/straight-line diagnostics retained
step6.adoption: candidate remains explicit; no universal default change or superiority claim based on pooled win alone
step6.failures: retain all records and refused outputs; no tuning on this panel

compatibility: Old numerical cores, original source, physical kernels, B2/B3, reports and old experiment outputs preserved
